name: piano-fundamentals-trainer
description: Android tablet piano fundamentals trainer with native Bluetooth MIDI input.
author: Natural516

scripts.build:android:debug: tsc --noEmit -p prototype/android-tablet-v1/tsconfig.json && vite build --mode android-debug --config vite.android-prototype.config.ts
scripts.build:android:release: tsc --noEmit -p prototype/android-tablet-v1/tsconfig.json && vite build --mode android-release --config vite.android-prototype.config.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android:debug && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:release: npm run build:android:release && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync:release && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.test:public: npm run android:apk:debug && npm run test:android-active-practice-session && npm run test:android-chord-theory && npm run test:android-chord-judgement && npm run test:android-chord-runtime && npm run test:android-chord-sequential && npm run test:android-chord-persistence && npm run test:android-chord-report-detail && npm run test:android-chord-ui && npm run test:android-chord-query-tool && npm run test:android-scale-key-signature-tool && npm run test:android-interval-query-tool && npm run test:android-navigation-ia && npm run test:android-practice-keep-awake && npm run test:android-double-note && npm run test:android-icon && npm run test:android-updater && npm run test:android-updater:native && npm run test:android-updater:network && npm run test:android-history && npm run test:android-persistence && npm run test:android-signing && npm run test:android-bluetooth-midi && npm run test:android-bluetooth-midi:native && npm run test:android-integration && npm run test:sight-reading && npm run typecheck
